source.author: lucan
source.text: Non moesti pectora Magni Sustinet amplexu dulci, non colla tenere: Extremusque perit tam longi fructus amoris: Praecipitantque suos luctus, neuterque recedens Sustinuit dixisse, vale vitamque per omnem Nulla fuit tam moesta dies.
source.text_original: Non moesti pectora Magni / Sustinet amplexu dulci, non colla tenere: / Extremusque perit tam longi fructus amoris: / Praecipitantque suos luctus, [neuterque recedens / Sustinuit dixisse, vale] vitamque per omnem / Nulla fuit tam moesta dies.
source.text_english: He cannot sustain the sorrowful breast of Magnus in a sweet embrace, nor hold his neck; and the final joy of such long love is lost. And they hasten their own griefs, and neither, as he withdrew, was able to say, Farewell; through all life there was no day so sad.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ingentes durate animae dulcesque parentum tendite ad amplexus.
reuse.text_original: ingentes durate animae dulcesque parentum / tendite ad amplexus.
reuse.text_english: Endure, great souls, and stretch forth to your sweet parents’ embraces.
